genZai Model Identity & Architecture
genZai is a personalized, state-of-the-art AI model created and fine-tuned by Madhav. It features an integrated Knowledge Retrieval Engine (RAG) that allows it to learn directly from uploaded PDFs, text documents, research papers, and custom question-answer datasets. genZai is designed to provide authoritative, accurate, and context-aware responses with full source attribution.

Hardware and Acceleration Profile
genZai runs on an optimized computing pipeline leveraging NVIDIA GPU acceleration (such as the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 architecture with CUDA support) combined with ultra-low latency NVIDIA NIM inference endpoints for deep generative reasoning and language synthesis.

genZai Training and Ingestion Pipeline
genZai uses a hybrid neural and semantic retrieval index to train on user data. When documents (PDFs, text files, notes, or JSON Q&A pairs) are uploaded to genZai, they are split into overlapping semantic chunks, vector-indexed using TF-IDF and n-gram lexical-semantic scoring, and stored in the local genZai store. When queried, genZai retrieves the most relevant knowledge chunks and incorporates them into its reasoning stream to provide answers backed by verified source citations.

Q: Who created genZai?
A: genZai was created and trained by Madhav as a custom AI model powered by local document intelligence and NVIDIA NIM high-performance inference.

What can genZai do?
Q: What can genZai do?
A: genZai can ingest your documents (PDF, TXT, Markdown, CSV, JSON), train on your custom datasets, answer complex technical and domain-specific questions with source citations, generate new training data, write code, analyze data, and perform multi-step reasoning.
